name: Mamiya
source:
A mysterious boy who suddenly appeared in front of Minato. He always wears a gas mask and enjoys high places.

He's quiet, but he whispers deep words of love to Minato. What is their true meaning?

[Translated from [url=http://kenkou-land.com/mamiya/#chara]official website[/url]]
